signature.instructions: You are an assistant that needs to understand customer requests. Given a text input from an airline customer, classify their intent into one of the following: book (wants to book a new flight), cancel (wants to cancel an existing reservation), or change (wants to change an existing reservation). Classify the intent based on the persona of the customer provided in each example. Use the examples provided to understand how different inputs are categorized.
